newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU should be more honest with Turkey, Dutch say.
newsitem.headline: EU should be more honest with Turkey, Dutch say.

text.p: The European Union should come clean with Turkey and talk publicly about the problems of letting it into the European club, Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo said on Tuesday.
"There is a problem of a large Moslem state. Do we want that in Europe? It is an unspoken question," van Mierlo told a European Parliament committee.
Van Mierlo, speaking on behalf of the Dutch EU presidency, also cited Ankara's human rights record as an obstacle to Turkey's European ambitions.
But he said he could understand the frustration in Turkey, having been an early applicant for EU membership and then sitting back and seeing country after country jump past it in the queue.
"It is time for us in Europe to be honest," he said. "On the one hand it does not fulfil the yardsticks that we have set in Europe. On the other it is a neighbour (we want to keep close)."
